messages:
Alex Carter: handing off now — summary: short spike of 502s from hosted API to customers in eu-west-1 starting ~10m ago, impact ~5% of requests, most from streaming endpoints. primary oncall for this shift is me, I'm handing to Priya as primary, Jorge as secondary. here's what we've done so far:

Oncall Bot: INCIDENT #INF-2026-314 detected - 502 error rate >3% for 5m on service:redwood-api (eu-west-1)

Priya Nair: thanks — quick Q: is this customer-visible errors (non-retryable) or upstream 502 that clients can retry?

Alex Carter: looks like gateway 502s (nginx) returned to clients, some retries succeed. root cause leaning towards a model-serving process crash on a dedicated pool handling streaming sessions => causing upstream to return 502.

Jorge Morales: any affected model variants pinned? could be a bad binary/quantization path.

Alex Carter: affected variant is `rwd-llama-13b-quant` on pool `dedicated-stream-eu`. We scaled that pool earlier and a rolling restart landed ~15m before spike.

Taylor (infra): noted. I ran `kubectl logs -n serving rwd-llama-13b-quant-*/container` and saw repeated OOM-ish GC logs followed by segfaults. paste:```
2026-07-14T09:12:03Z ERROR runtime: signal SIGSEGV
2026-07-14T09:12:04Z INFO restarting process
```

Priya Nair: ok, mitigation plan for next shift: 1) detach traffic from `dedicated-stream-eu` and route to `dedicated-stream-eu-fallback` (variant `rwd-llama-13b-8bit`) 2) rollback the restart (if the restart included any package change) 3) throttle long-poll streaming sessions for 10m.

Alex Carter: I've already opened a temporary route and GradualTrafficPolicy to shift 60% to fallback. command used:```redwoodctl route adjust --pool dedicated-stream-eu --to-pool dedicated-stream-eu-fallback --pct 60```

Oncall Bot: Action recorded: Traffic shift initiated by Alex Carter at 2039000050.

Jorge Morales: file a ticket for a proper postmortem and follow-up action items, include SRE and runtime-eng. Tagging infra for memory/GC investigation.

Alex Carter: ticket created: INF-2026-3141 — title: "502s from dedicated-stream-eu after rolling restart". link: <https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-2026-3141>

Priya Nair: during handoff: I will monitor error rate and latency for 30m. If 502 rate >1% for two consecutive 5m windows or p95 latency >900ms, escalate to SRE and start full traffic cutover to fallback (90%).

Taylor (infra): note on runbook: follow runbook `runbooks/serving/streaming-502s` — key knobs: `max-connections-per-worker`, `kv-cache-size`, and enable `prefer-fallback-variant`. link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving/streaming-502s>

Priya Nair: copying runbook into thread for quick checks:
```
- check pool health: redwoodctl pool status dedicated-stream-eu
- check pod restarts: kubectl get pods -n serving --selector=pool=dedicated-stream-eu
- check memory OOMs: kubectl describe pod <pod> | grep -i oom
- shift traffic: redwoodctl route adjust ...
```

Jorge Morales: coverage note — I'm on call for next 4h but will be out of reach 1:30–2:00 UTC for a meeting. Priya, can you cover during that 30m window?

Priya Nair: yes I can cover that 30m. Alex, please add a comment in the ticket about the potential memory regression and attach core dumps if available.

Alex Carter: added logs and core dumps to INF-2026-3141. Also pinned the golden-requests set for quality checks.

Oncall Bot: Note: scheduled postmortem meeting created by Alex Carter — 2039003600 (1h from now) — calendar <https://redwood.internal/calendar/INF-2026-3141-postmortem>

Priya Nair: action items for post-handoff: [PR1] runtime-eng to investigate GC tuning and fallback variant behavior (assigned Jorge), [PR2] infra to review rolling restart pipeline (assigned Taylor), [PR3] product/sales to notify high-impact customers (Alex to coordinate).

Jorge Morales: will start with reproducer against `rwd-llama-13b-quant` using a controlled load test, collect heap profiles. planning to push a temporary `--max-connections-per-worker=80` flag.

Alex Carter: FYI for next primary: don't forget to check `metrics:streaming_errors_by_variant` and `routes:traffic_pct` in Console — I left an annotation at 2039000100 where we started the shift.

Priya Nair: taking over now as primary. I'll ping here with status updates every 10m or on any significant change. Thanks Alex, Jorge, Taylor. :thumbsup:

Alex Carter: thanks — handoff complete.

Priya Nair: 10m update: 502s down to 0.8%, p95 latency improved 20%. continuing to monitor.

Jorge Morales: started heap profile run, attaching pointer to artifacts in ticket.

Priya Nair: 25m update: 502s steady at 0.5%, moving to 80% fallback cutover at 2039000175 to be safe. will leave 20% on original pool for postmortem traces.

Oncall Bot: Incident INF-2026-314 status: mitigated (errors below threshold) — keep monitoring for recurrence.

Priya Nair: follow-ups before next rotation: 1) confirm memory leak/regression root cause in INF-2026-3141 2) schedule in-depth postmortem w/ runtime-eng & infra (already created) 3) update runbook with `prefer-fallback-variant` as recommended default for streaming after restarts 4) ensure customer notifications were sent.

Alex Carter: I confirmed notifications sent to two affected customers — copied receipts to ticket. closing my handoff thread. good luck Priya.

Priya Nair: noted, I'll close incident when we hit 2 hours of stable metrics and move action items to sprint board.

Oncall Bot: Thread archived for channel `eng-oncall` (incident mitigated).
